sourceAnchors.name: Ninon de Lenclos
sourceAnchors.detail: advised the Marquis de Sevigne to hide his seduction aim rather than end the guessing game
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Ninon saw that the declared aim gives the other person something solid to resist.

sourceAnchors.name: the Marquis de Sevigne
sourceAnchors.detail: lost leverage when he declared love and made his intention readable
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The Marquis lost the advantage the moment desire stopped being ambiguous.

sourceAnchors.name: Otto von Bismarck
sourceAnchors.detail: hid his appetite for war behind peaceful language until the position was his
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Bismarck sounded peaceful because an obvious appetite for war would have armed the room against him.
